title: Lime user configuration

llm_rerank_count.description: Length of the leading Rime candidate prefix checked for complete-input candidates before LLM reranking.

llm_effective_count.description: Number of top LLM-ranked complete candidates promoted ahead of the Rime order.

llm_inference_count_limit.description: Maximum number of candidate continuation inference batches per input request.

llm_ignore_emoji.description: Exclude candidates containing Emoji code points from LLM reranking while preserving Rime order.

llm_backend.description: Preferred llama.cpp native backend; CUDA falls back to CPU when unavailable.

description: Current management configuration. Cross-field bounds are enforced by lime-core::ConfigStore.
